title: [Synthetic hard] Bristol shipment — English + German, five speakers
reference_status: Assistant-authored synthetic listening trial; not native-speaker validated

people.name: Anna
people.style: Adult woman logistics manager, fluent German and English, native German accent, firm and slightly impatient, spontaneous conversation.

people.name: Lukas
people.style: Adult man warehouse lead, native German, fluent English with German accent, defensive when interrupted, natural conversation.

people.name: Priya
people.style: Adult woman customer lead, clear Indian English, urgent but professional, natural conversation.

people.name: Ben
people.style: Adult man finance analyst, Scottish English accent, low register, precise, sometimes frustrated, natural conversation.

people.name: Eva
people.style: Adult woman quality specialist, native German, fluent English with German accent, emphatic and technical, natural conversation.

turns.speaker: anna
turns.text: Anna hier. Wir müssen die Lieferung nach Bristol klären. Bitte keine Vermutungen als Fakten weitergeben. Priya, what has the customer actually been told?

turns.speaker: priya
turns.text: Priya speaking. They were promised forty-eight crates on Thursday morning. Their installation team is already booked. They want a yes or no before five today.

turns.speaker: lukas
turns.text: Lukas hier. Vierundachtzig Kisten stehen auf der Liste, nicht achtundvierzig. Ich habe den Auftrag vor mir. Das Problem ist der falsche Lieferschein.

turns.speaker: priya
turns.text: No, forty-eight is the customer order. Eighty-four is the stock transfer. Those are different jobs. Please don't send the whole warehouse to Bristol.

turns.speaker: eva
turns.text: Eva hier. Genau. Achtundvierzig bestellt, vierundachtzig im internen Transfer. Aber sechs der achtundvierzig Kisten haben noch kein Prüfsiegel.

turns.speaker: ben
turns.text: Ben here. I heard sixty untested crates. If that's right, we cannot ship anything. Can someone repeat the number without talking over each other?

turns.speaker: eva
turns.text: Six, not sixty. Sechs Kisten sind noch nicht freigegeben. Zweiundvierzig haben die Prüfung bestanden. Ich spreche langsam, weil die Verbindung schlecht ist.

turns.speaker: anna
turns.text: Danke. Forty-eight ordered, forty-two approved, six awaiting inspection. Lukas, can the forty-two leave today, without mixing in the six?

turns.speaker: lukas
turns.text: Ja, wenn wir die sechs sofort sperren. Aber die Palette ist schon foliert. Neu sortieren dauert ungefähr eine Stunde. Der normale Laster fährt in vierzig Minuten.

turns.speaker: priya
turns.text: Could we send the six now and email the certificates later? The customer says their team can inspect them on arrival.

turns.speaker: eva
turns.text: Nein. Das ist keine Dokumentenfrage. Bei zwei Kisten gibt es einen offenen Temperaturbefund. Ohne Prüfung werden die sechs nicht versandt.

turns.speaker: anna
turns.text: Agreed. Sending unapproved crates is rejected. Lukas, quarantine those six and prepare the forty-two separately. Don't relabel anything as approved.

turns.speaker: ben
turns.text: The draft says express transport costs nine thousand six hundred euros. We can't approve that against this order's margin.

turns.speaker: lukas
turns.text: Das Angebot war für den gesamten Transfer. Für Bristol allein sind es neunhundertsechzig Euro. Neunhundertsechzig, nicht neuntausendsechshundert.

turns.speaker: ben
turns.text: Okay, nine hundred and sixty for this shipment. Is that the final invoice, or just a ceiling? The notes need to distinguish those.

turns.speaker: anna
turns.text: A ceiling. I approve up to nine hundred and sixty euros for the forty-two cleared crates. Any amount above that comes back to me before booking.

turns.speaker: priya
turns.text: Then I'll tell the customer forty-two crates arrive Thursday morning and the remaining six arrive Friday. That at least gives them something firm.

turns.speaker: eva
turns.text: Freitag ist noch nicht bestätigt. Die Prüfung kann morgen fertig werden, aber wenn der Temperaturbefund bleibt, müssen wir Ersatz suchen.

turns.speaker: anna
turns.text: Please don't promise Friday. The forty-two can be planned for Thursday only after the carrier confirms. There is no delivery commitment for the remaining six.

turns.speaker: ben
turns.text: Who is booking the carrier? I wrote down Priya, but she seems to own the customer conversation rather than transport.

turns.speaker: lukas
turns.text: Ich buche den Transport. Priya spricht mit dem Kunden. Ich brauche die schriftliche Freigabe und die Palettennummern bis sechzehn Uhr dreißig.

turns.speaker: eva
turns.text: Ich schicke dir die Liste der zweiundvierzig freigegebenen Kisten bis sechzehn Uhr fünfzehn. Die sechs gesperrten stehen separat auf einer zweiten Liste.

turns.speaker: anna
turns.text: Good. Lukas books by sixteen thirty, once Eva's approved list is in. Priya, send the customer update by seventeen fifteen, and copy me.

turns.speaker: priya
turns.text: Seventeen fifteen is later than the customer's request for five. I can send an interim update at sixteen forty-five, then the final transport details at seventeen fifteen.

turns.speaker: anna
turns.text: Yes. Interim update at sixteen forty-five, confirmed transport details by seventeen fifteen. Explain that the six crates remain under inspection, with no promised arrival date.

turns.speaker: ben
turns.text: I've just received the carrier note. It says nine hundred and sixty excludes a two hundred euro fuel charge. So the current quote is eleven hundred and sixty.

turns.speaker: lukas
turns.text: Dann passt das Angebot nicht zur Freigabe. Ich kann einen anderen Anbieter anrufen. Bitte nicht einfach die Grenze erhöhen, bevor wir verglichen haben.

turns.speaker: anna
turns.text: Keep the ceiling at nine hundred and sixty. Lukas, ask for an all-inclusive quote. If no carrier accepts, escalate to me; don't book over the limit.

turns.speaker: eva
turns.text: Die sechs Kisten sind jetzt im System gesperrt. Das ist erledigt. Die Liste für die zweiundvierzig fehlt noch; die schicke ich wie vereinbart um sechzehn Uhr fünfzehn.

turns.speaker: ben
turns.text: So quarantining the six is completed, but the approved list and transport booking are still open. I'll record the extra fuel charge as an unapproved proposal.

turns.speaker: priya
turns.text: And the customer's installation cancellation fee? They mentioned it in their message, but I haven't accepted responsibility or agreed to pay it.

turns.speaker: anna
turns.text: Leave that unresolved. Send the claim to legal for review, Priya, by tomorrow at ten. This call does not approve compensation.

turns.speaker: eva
turns.text: Zur Zusammenfassung: achtundvierzig bestellt, zweiundvierzig freigegeben, sechs gesperrt. Für die sechs gibt es noch keinen Liefertermin. Keine Freigabe ohne Prüfung.

turns.speaker: lukas
turns.text: Ich hole ein Angebot inklusive aller Zuschläge und buche bis sechzehn Uhr dreißig, wenn es unter neunhundertsechzig Euro bleibt. Sonst melde ich mich bei Anna.

turns.speaker: priya
turns.text: I send an interim customer update at sixteen forty-five, transport details by seventeen fifteen, and the compensation claim to legal by ten tomorrow. No promise for the six.

turns.speaker: anna
turns.text: Exactly. The Thursday plan for forty-two crates depends on carrier confirmation. Quarantine is done, inspection and booking are still open. We'll regroup at sixteen thirty-five.

facts.text: 48 ordered, 84 internal transfer, 42 approved, 6 unapproved; six not sixty.
Unapproved six may not ship; quarantine completed; their delivery date remains unknown.
EUR 960 all-inclusive spending ceiling unchanged; EUR 1160 including fuel unapproved.
Eva sends approved list by 16:15; Lukas books by 16:30 only within ceiling, otherwise escalates to Anna.
Priya interim 16:45, transport details 17:15; legal compensation referral by 10:00 tomorrow.
Thursday for 42 depends on carrier; Friday for six rejected; compensation not approved.
